notes.title: Black Screen - SOLVED x2 (solutions at bottom)
notes.content:
Someone with Windows 10 reported that they get audio but no visuals. On my new computer, I seem to have the same problem, even though I've played the game successfully on Windows 10 and 7 on multiple computers in multiple countries. Looking into it! 

One source I'm looking at ATM: 

https://steamcommunity.com/discussions/forum/1/523898291513495130/

Possible problems and solutions: 

1) You might need to reinstall the game.
2) You might need to update your graphics card driver. 
3) You might need to roll back your graphics card driver. 

Is this happening for other games? If so, that would be a useful piece of information. Still looking. Thanks! 

SOLUTION 1: I have not personally tested this solution, but I think it's definitely a worth a shot. 

1) Go to your Library tab in Steam
2) Right click Dreamblaster and click Properties
3) Click Local Files tab and click Browse Local Files...
4) Right click the Dreamblaster.exe file and click Properties
5) Click the Compatibility tab
6) Check the "Run this program in compatibility mode for:" box
7) Use the dropdown to select Windows XP (try either SP)
8) Click Apply 

You should be good!

SOLUTION 2: I rolled back my graphics card driver.

1) Hold the Windows button and press X 
2) Click Device Manager
3) Expand Display adapters
4) Right click your graphics card and click Properties 
5) Go to the Driver tab
6) Click Roll Back Driver 
7) Confirm and complete process

You should be good!

notes.title: Release and other stuff
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29238314/8882f907f581727457f745f198d5efa1b7fd3399.jpg][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29238314/bcc14e929ddbd1fa9437f5bbcec23f8c216bc52a.jpg[/img][/url]

---Release---

After much testing, I believe the game is ready to rock! I'm going to release on the 6th as intended. 

---Bugs---

There are virtually none of these. If you find one, report it. I do have a fondness for one bug that is funny and potentially helpful to the player. I will not be destroying that one! 

---Merchandise---

Working on some shirts at the moment. In fact, my graphic designer pal is sending me some work of his tomorrow. Until then, I just have this very simple placeholder design (more designs to come over the next 24 hours):  https://teespring.com/khaulepi#pid=2&cid=2397&sid=front

---Achievements and Leaderboards---

These are functional. I don't know of any issues, but you'll let me know, right? There's a way to reset achievements and such, assuming you want that. At the splash screen ("Khaulepi"), hold X and press 0 to reset all Steam achievements for the game. If you hold Z and press 0, you will reset all nonSteam accomplishments within the game.
